How to connect Plex to BingeSync

1

Open Plex Web Settings

Log in to Plex Media Server web client as administrator or Plex Pass user, click the Wrench icon (Settings) in the top right.

2

Navigate to Webhooks

In the left sidebar under Manage, select Webhooks.

3

Add Webhook

Click Add Webhook, paste your personal Webhook URL above, and click Save Changes.

4

Start Binging!

Whenever you play or finish watching movies and series, Plex automatically sends scrobbles to BingeSync in real-time.

TheTVDB Metadata Integration

BingeSync automatically enriches your scrobble timeline in the background with genres, cast/actor details, director credits, and plot summaries retrieved from TheTVDB.

OpenID Connect Back-Channel Logout URL

Provide this endpoint to your OpenID Connect Provider (e.g. Authentik, PocketID, Keycloak). When a user loses group access or is revoked/disabled, the IdP sends a revocation token to terminate their active sessions immediately.

Import Watch History

Upload your Trakt.tv exported data (.zip archive, .json, or .csv). BingeSync will extract all history and rating files, automatically sort chronologically, and maintain exact timestamps and ratings (1-10).
